analysis.title: Asia Open - Trendless
key_insights: SPX fell 2.02% for a sixth consecutive losing session, the longest streak since April 2024. All 11 sectors closed lower and spot VIX rose past 28.
Nvidia's earnings did not act as the clearing event markets hoped for. Sentiment worsened after the Anthropic IPO debuted 34% above issue price and then reversed sharply.
SPX closed below its 200-day moving average and below the support trend line from the Liberation day low at $7,245 (ref $7,175).
Cash desk flows were skewed toward buying Healthcare, Industrials and Energy, and selling Info Tech, Financials, Consumer Discretionary, Comm Services and Consumer Staples.
USTs bull steepened in a flight-to-quality bid a day after the Oct Fed minutes suggested growing concern about shifting AI sentiment. Jan OIS pricing fell to 67% from 71%.
Citi economists do not expect officials to pursue aggressive rate hikes if sentiment materially worsens and financial conditions tighten substantially.
The $19B 10-year TIPS auction stopped at a 2.903% yield with a bid/cover of 2.43, at the 73rd percentile of the past 12 auctions.

DXY traded at 103.94. EM currencies were weakest, led by LatAm (BRL, MXN, COP). EUR was comparatively resilient, GBP weakened after Wednesday's services inflation miss, and USDJPY traded just below 160.
eFX desk volumes were about 10% above average from 12:00 to 19:00 GMT, with net flows toward buying CNH and HUF and selling MXN and ZAR.

Crude rose 0.70% as Iranian attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz multiplied, and Trump said he is in no rush to escalate and may defer action until the new year. Gold (-3%) fell for a fourth session to a 15-month low under a hawkish Fed.

The BCB sold $1bn spot USD at 5.86 across five dealers after USDBRL reached 5.927. The pair retraced fully in the broader risk-off move. Citi's trader keeps an offsides position until Q1 2027, when seasonal weakness subsides.
Citi economists expect an unchanged China LPR (1y 3.00%, 5y 3.50%), see a November cut as not plausible, and expect the PBoC on hold through 2026 followed by two 10bp cuts in 2027E.
earnings_insights: Nvidia's earnings were described as blowout but did not end the equity selloff. The note gives no EPS or revenue figures.
